label: For "Payment Authorization Rate Uplift (Issuer-Side Retry & Tokenisation)": Recover soft-declined payments by predicting when a retry, network token or 3DS step-up will succeed, lifting authorisation rates by 1-3 points. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Observational retry data confounded by who was retried.
